ModMetaData.name: Regrowth Grass Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces the Regrowth grass art (Plant_Grass and Plant_TallGrass share Things/Plant/RG_Grass) with a render generated for this campaign (Greentide sheet 2026-10-05, owner pick B). ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
